title: HB 1219 (2008 Regular Session): Elections; require voter identification when appear to vote.
operative_text:
(a_in_person_id)
(section) Sec. 1(1)
(quote) Each person who shall appear to vote in person at a polling place or the registrar's office shall be required to identify himself or herself to an election manager or the registrar by presenting current and valid photo identification before such person shall be allowed to vote.
(section) Sec. 1(2)
(quote) The identification required by subsection (1) of this section shall include, but not be limited to, the following: (a) A current and valid Mississippi driver's license; (b) A current and valid identification card containing a photograph of the elector issued by a branch, department, agency or entity of the State of Mississippi; (c) A current and valid United States passport;
(b_no_id_remedy) not stated.
(c_mail_ballot_id)
(section) Sec. 2(2) (23-15-631)
(quote) The Secretary of State shall prepare instructions on how absent voters may comply with the identification requirements of the Help America Vote Act of 2002, which shall be provided to the registrar and enclosed with each absentee ballot.
(section) Sec. 3(3) (23-15-639)
(quote) The election managers shall also take such action as may be prescribed by the Secretary of State to ensure compliance with the identification requirements of the Help America Vote Act of 2002.
(section) Sec. 6 (23-15-719)
(quote) The registrar shall identify the applicant by requiring him to present identification as required by Section 1 of House Bill No.
(d_proof_of_citizenship) not stated.
(e_other_rule) not stated.
